questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A ball's height is h = -16t² + 48t + 4 feet after t seconds. Write and solve an equation to find when the ball is 36 feet high.
questions.prompt_markup:
A ball's height is h = -16t² + 48t + 4 feet after t seconds.
Write and solve an equation to find when the ball is 36 feet high.
questions.grading_note: Form required: an equation and both times. -16t² + 48t - 32 = 0, so t² - 3t + 2 = 0 and (t - 1)(t - 2) = 0. The ball passes 36 ft going up and coming down.

questions.grading_note: Form required: an equation and both dimensions. w² + 5w - 84 = (w + 12)(w - 7) = 0; a width cannot be -12.
